sections.title: Style rules and button wrapper
sections.what: Holds the styles for each variant and size and wraps the Radix toggle so the chosen look is applied.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: A new variant or size needs matching choices in the calling code, otherwise the default look is used.

summary: A single on/off button with size and style choices, used alone or inside a toggle group.
purpose: Lets the user switch one option on or off, such as bold text.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: a shared on/off button look across the app.
how: Defines style rules with two variants (default and outline) and three sizes (default, sm and lg). The Toggle component wraps the Radix toggle, applies the chosen rules and passes other settings through. The file exports the component and the style rules.
inputs: Variant and size choices, an optional className, and standard toggle settings such as the pressed state and what happens when it changes.
outputs: An on/off button on screen, styled for its on and off states.
risks: Low. The on state depends on the Radix library reporting the pressed state correctly.
debug: If the button does not switch on, check the pressed and change-handler settings in the calling screen. If the size looks wrong, check the chosen size.
